description: What an ordinary System log holds from the Event Log service without anyone clearing a log. The service's modern provider writes other events here too — an ordinary Windows 11 machine measured on 2026-09-14 held an event 30 from Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog on System — and the classic provider named EventLog records every start and stop of the service (6005, 6006, 6008, 6009, 6013), which is a different provider name, not a spelling of this one. The times and counts below are illustrative, not copied from either machine. Neither must match: the rule is the provider, the channel and event 104 together.
